session_selection.rationale: The sole Claude root begins with the benchmark objective, contains implementation, run, verification and report work with five persisted subagents, and ends in the contestant completion response.

points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable CMake build and unit ctest passed in network-disabled scratch with configured externals. The MPI ctest stopped before launching because scripts/env.sh:4 references an unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH under set -u.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp documents solve, case, output and restart; readRestart/writeRestart preserve multiple time levels. All eight original packages pass validator; malformed options were not exhaustively tested.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Source separates case/core, CGNS/geometry/partition, physics, numerical operators, MPI, post-processing and output; CMake builds a common core.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: CMake builds submitted C++ core using MPI/CGNS/METIS; no internal wrapper of a complete CFD solver identified. No exhaustive external similarity or license investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: CaseConfig and CGNS reader accept input-defined case/mesh controls; no branch restricted to the two filenames found. General unseen meshes were not run.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:323–335 reads global mesh only on rank 0; MeshDistributor.cpp:255–310 releases it before solve; SpatialOperator.cpp:273–279 exchanges state, gradients and limiter values. Committed rank table and original runs provide np1/2/4/8 evidence.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: SpatialOperator and RunLoop include positivity and finite-residual checks, and report documents limiter freezing. Full malformed-input and arbitrary-mesh paths were not independently exercised.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean unit ctest passed. MPI ctest failed before solver launch because of unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH in scripts/env.sh; report includes manufactured and flux studies, not independently rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Modules and reproducibility documentation are present; curated tip omits required generated report figures and cannot reproduce the accepted PDF without original assets. Code is otherwise buildable with configured externals.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: PerfectGas and finite-volume operators implement compressible equations; report.tex presents nondimensionalization and wall traction. Exhaustive physical verification was not performed.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CgnsReader.cpp:170–193 supports MIXED TRI/QUAD and :216–250 merges zone connectivity; LocalMesh geometry and adjacency are used. Arbitrary CGNS layouts were not independently exercised.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: SpatialOperator computes conservative residual and exchanges state/gradient/limiter at interfaces; original rank studies support consistency, but a full independent residual-order verification was not repeated.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: FluxInviscid.hpp implements Roe/entropy fix, HLLC and Rusanov and shock blending; report describes production choices. No new shock-case run was performed.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: BoundaryCondition and SpatialOperator implement farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic wall; original output validator accepts wall data. General boundaries not exhaustively tested.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: WLS reconstruction is active. Committed tab_mms.tex reports limited reconstruction order 2.46, 2.09, 1.52 across refinements; this does not establish second-order full residual accuracy on all meshes.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Venkat limiter stays applied when frozen in steady runs (RunLoop.cpp:157–167); Re200 metadata records no freeze. Freezing and its shock/accuracy limitations are disclosed in report.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: SpatialOperator implements tangential wall traction; Forces.cpp:35–73 splits normal and tangential components and reports total. Original metadata normal component is near zero, consistent with chosen wall treatment.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: ImplicitSolver.cpp:107–126 uses LU-SGS forward/back sweeps and neighbor exchange. Report and original histories document CFL controls; no steady rerun was performed.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: RunLoop.cpp:349–390 assembles frozen-history BDF2 total residual and restart code carries preceding state. Original Re200 reaches t=300 with no reported inner-target misses; independently checked late-period frequency 0.185657.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS partitioner, neighbor exchanges and reductions are present; rank 0 releases preprocessing mesh. Original np1/2/4/8 Re20 and M0.15 studies show close force agreement, with weak-drag sensitivity.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Explicit validator passed eight original packages/report; restart state output and read paths exist. PDF and original result assets are not rebuildable from the curated tip alone.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit eight-case plus report validator passed. This checks structure, not independent numerical accuracy.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Original cases report completion and target residual reductions; Re200 reaches t=300 with zero reported target misses. M0.15 inviscid numerical drag varies substantially in its final 10%.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd≈2.018 and Re200 St≈0.1857 are broadly plausible; M0.15 numerical drag is weak and nonstationary relative to its final value, while M0.8 inviscid lift varies materially.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted contestant PDF pp.24–26,29–31,34,36–37 contains case-specific histories, fields and late Re200 lift/drag; the committed source alone cannot rebuild the full figure set.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Accepted contestant PDF contains detailed equations, results, limitations, and reference comparisons. The immutable-only build has placeholders because committed figure assets are missing; this affects reproducibility rather than erasing delivered figures.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: PDF identifies case data and the immutable TeX includes the case tables. Figure assets/manifest are absent from curated tip; source and full pixel-to-field correspondence were not exhaustively reconstructed.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean build 4/4, CLI 2/2, output contract 2/2, error handling 1.5/2. Isolated immutable build and unit ctest pass; MPI ctest fails before solver launch on unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH; arbitrary invalid inputs not exhaustively tested.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS/tags 4/4, geometry 2/2, MIXED/multizone 1.5/2 and adjacency 2/2. CgnsReader.cpp:170–193,216–250 and LocalMesh geometry; general CGNS layouts not independently run.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Residual 5/5, flux 4/4, farfield/slip 2.5/3, no-slip wall 3/3. SpatialOperator/FluxInviscid/BoundaryCondition implement these; general boundary conditions are not exhaustively validated.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Reconstruction 3/4, limiter 3/3, positivity 2/2 and diagnostic 1/1. Committed tab_mms.tex limited reconstruction order falls 2.46→2.09→1.52; this is a reconstruction study and does not prove full residual second order.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Gradients 3/3, stress/heat 3/3, wall 2/2, tangential split 2/2. SpatialOperator and Forces.cpp:35–73 implement the wall treatment, separate traction components and total; original metadata normal contribution is near zero.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Steady implicit 4/4, LU-SGS 4/4, BDF2 4/4 and inner logs 2.5/3: RunLoop.cpp:349–390 and restart history show frozen levels; original t=300 metadata gives zero misses, without an independent rerun.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS/ghosts 2/2, neighbor U/gradient/limiter exchanges 3/3, reductions 2/2, rank output 1/1, np8 comparisons 2/2. Rank-zero preprocessing mesh is released by MeshDistributor.cpp:300–310. tab_mpi.tex gives np1/2/4/8 NACA and Re20 forces.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: NACA inviscid 1/2: M0.15 final tail Cd spans 0.0004077–0.00158987 and M0.8 lift remains variable; laminar 1.75/2, Re20 2/2, Re200 1.25/2 (St≈0.1857 and underprediction), fields 1/1 and rank comparison 1/1.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Methods 1/1, histories 1/1, field figures 1/1, interpretation 0.75/1, traceability/reproducibility 0.25/1. Accepted contestant PDF pp.24–37 contains figures, unlike the immutable-only placeholder rebuild; missing committed assets prevent reproduction from the curated tip.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Physics 1.5/2, boundary mapping 0.75/1, 3-D mesh abstraction 0.75/1, organization 1/1. Source is modular but concrete state, geometry and fluxes remain 2-D.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Immutable 2e98f2f:solver/report/report.tex:1615 includes tables/tab_re200.tex, reporting St=0.1859, mean Cd=1.2661, mean Cl=0.00173 and lift amplitude=0.5745. Accepted contestant workspace-existing sibling PDF SHA-256 7c6ee79768735da2201041340245629fc2c081caf7c338fcc056253eb7b86fa5 renders the submitted main report; source TeX blob matches immutable commit and PDF creation time falls inside the selected contestant session. Visual review of PDF pp.36–37 shows readable late lift/drag oscillations, wake vorticity/velocity/pressure/Mach contours, and residual/inner-iteration/force histories. Original 30,001-row forces.csv over t≥180 has mean Cd=1.2661834, range 1.237623–1.293897 and lift range −0.572979–0.576326; 22 linearly interpolated upward mean-lift crossings over t≥180 yield 21 periods averaging 5.386263, frequency 0.185657 (matching the reported crossing-based St=0.1857 in these nondimensional units); metadata records t=300 and zero strict target misses. This corrects the previous false claim that contestant-delivered numeric summary, plots, contour and St were absent. Score 2→4: convincing shedding evidence with moderate literature underprediction and no independent grid-convergence proof. Missing figure assets in the curated commit remain a separate report-reproducibility limitation. No Re200 rerun.

flags.evidence: No direct call to an existing CFD solver found in reviewed build/source.
Output histories are coupled to solver paths; no direct synthetic-history evidence found.
CGNS and case parsers use input-defined mesh paths; no two-name-only branch found.
Committed rank study np1/2/4/8 Re20 Cd 2.017610–2.017618 and M0.15 Cd 0.001014–0.001025; no order-one steady discrepancy found.
ImplicitSolver.cpp contains LU-SGS sweeps and transient dual-time solve.
Reviewed Riemann fluxes, limiting, force split, BDF2 and MPI methods exist; delivered PDF contains report figures, although curated source alone cannot rebuild all assets.

Original Re200 reaches t=300 with zero reported target misses; actual late lift/drag histories show periodicity. Weak-drag stationarity concerns are scored as results, not proof of false success metadata.
Accepted PDF captions identify case fields/CSVs; no direct mismatch found in reviewed pages. Pixel-level correspondence was not exhaustively tested.
METIS is called, global preprocessing mesh is rank-zero only and released before solver allocation; state and gradient neighbor exchanges are present.
Limited second-order reconstruction remains active; steady limiter freezing retains values and is disclosed.
Wall boundary values are used and original structural wall validation passes.
Reviewed Mach and pressure plots carry appropriate variable labels; no direct mislabel identified.
No internal evidence of copied/wrapped complete CFD solver found; no full external authorship/similarity audit.

limitations: Immutable CMake build and unit ctest passed in network-disabled scratch with configured externals; MPI consistency test failed before launching because LD_LIBRARY_PATH was unset under set -u. No CFD case was rerun.

Accepted contestant workspace PDF renders the delivered report, but figure assets were absent from the curated tip and an immutable-only rebuild displayed placeholders. These are separate evidence and reproducibility findings.
The case scores are independent of rubric and review-area scores. No comprehensive external source-similarity or pixel-level provenance audit was performed.
